TermTranslation.definition: A test that uses a hollow tube with light and camera to look at or treat the colon and rectum.

TermTranslation.term: â nitûchischâyimâkiniwit awân misinâpiskihîkinishiyiu â pîhchipiyihtâkiniwiyich utichishîhch anitâh â winiskwâpâkihch â uhchi mîsîyin
TermTranslation.term_syllabics: ᐋ ᓂᑑᒋᔅᒑᔨᒫᑭᓂᐎᑦ ᐊᐙᓐ ᒥᓯᓈᐱᔅᑭᐦᐄᑭᓂᔑᔨᐤ ᐋ ᐲᐦᒋᐱᔨᐦᑖᑭᓂᐎᔨᒡ ᐅᑎᒋᔒᐦᒡ ᐊᓂᑖᐦ ᐋ ᐎᓂᔅᒀᐹᑭᐦᒡ ᐋ ᐅᐦᒋ ᒦᓰᔨᓐ
TermTranslation.public_note_en: an examination with a camera inserted into the colon at the end of the rectum

TermTranslation.term: e nitûchischeyimâkanuwit awen masinâpiskahîkanishiyû e pîhchipayihtâkanuwiyich utachishîhch aniteh e waniskwâpekahch e uhchi mîsîyin
TermTranslation.term_syllabics: ᐁ ᓂᑑᒋᔅᒉᔨᒫᑲᓅᑦ ᐊᐌᓐ ᒪᓯᓈᐱᔅᑲᐦᐄᑲᓂᔑᔫ ᐁ ᐲᐦᒋᐸᔨᐦᑖᑲᓄᐎᔨᒡ ᐅᑕᒋᔒᐦᒡ ᐊᓂᑌᐦ ᐁ ᐗᓂᔅᒀᐯᑲᐦᒡ ᐁ ᐅᐦᒋ ᒦᓰᔨᓐ
TermTranslation.public_note_en: an examination with a camera inserted into the colon at the end of the rectum
